safeguarding.title: Share a concern
safeguarding.consent_body: What you share here is reviewed by trained safeguarding staff. If you or someone else is in immediate danger, please call your local emergency number now (UK: 999, EU: 112).
safeguarding.consent_disclose: I understand my submission will be reviewed by safeguarding staff.
safeguarding.consent_contact: I am happy for the team to contact me about this submission.
safeguarding.anonymous: Submit anonymously (your name will not be attached)
safeguarding.on_behalf: I'm reporting on behalf of another person
safeguarding.draft_restored: A previous draft has been restored.
safeguarding.duplicate_warn: This looks very similar to submission #{sid} you sent recently. Submit again anyway?
safeguarding.triage_q3: Is anyone in immediate danger right now?
safeguarding.triage_q4: Have you told anyone else about this?
safeguarding.anon_token_heading: Save this code to check on your case
safeguarding.check_anon_not_found: No case found for that code.
